messages.author: b949e0841d7e094b
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: two suggestions..
parts: > sometimes you need to do something at the console, which requires you to stop the app.

if you edit something in global.R, for instance, you'll need to restart not just refresh, but I find I can go on for a long time by just refreshing the browser.

A simple thing to do to minimize interference with your browser for other uses, say if you're watching some stock quotes or soccer results while debugging, is simply to use different browsers for different things. I usually also set the port, say:

runApp("shiny-app", port=1936)

so I can set a "permanent" shortcut in my browser.

I don't know if it's possible to set a browser at launch, that would be convenient, like say:

runApp("shiny-app", port=1936, browser=firefox)
